title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 179
paragraphs: The following story is also told: that Jason, when he had completed the Argo beneath Mount Pelion, put in it a hecatomb and also a tripod of bronze, and sailed around the Peloponnese, wishing to come to Delphi. As he sailed and got near Malea, a north wind seized his ship and carried it off to Libya, and before he had caught sight of land he was already in the shoals of Lake Tritonis. As he was at a loss how to bring his ship out, the story goes that Triton appeared to him and told Jason to give him the tripod, saying he would show them the right course and let them go without harm. When Jason agreed, Triton showed them the passage out between the shoals and placed the tripod in his own temple, after first uttering a prophecy over the tripod and declaring to Jason and his crew the whole matter—namely, that whenever one of the descendants of those who had sailed with him in the Argo should carry off this tripod, then it was ordained by fate that a hundred cities of Hellenes would be founded around Lake Tritonis. On hearing this, the native Libyans hid the tripod.
